title: 第五章 前往教学楼
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

紧接着又一道系统提示音响起...

“恭喜拯救马洁任务完成”

“奖励发放”

“经验值+500”

“附魔武器已发放”

林夕在脑海中展开自己的面板属性

经验赫然达到了（810/1000）

“还差190的经验就可以升级了”林夕看着经验值心里想着

“同。。。同学你好。”一个当时跟马洁站在一起的女生走了上来颤颤巍巍的对着林夕说道

“有事吗？”林夕冷冰冰的对着那个女生回复道

那个女生仿佛很害怕林夕一样略显结巴的对林夕说道：“你可以带上我吗？”

林夕疑惑的说道：“为什么？”

那个女生仿佛被问懵了支支吾吾的半天说不出个所以然。

“喂，那个男生，把我们带上。”又一个声音传来。

林夕皱着眉头看向声音的来源，赫然就是林夕之前听到小声密谋的几个人之中为首的那个男生

林夕看了一眼他笑着说道：“凭什么？”

“凭什么？就凭我父亲是学校的副校长。”

林夕笑了，笑了一会问道：“如果我不带呢？”

那个男生紧接着说道：“一句话的事儿就可以把你开除。”

男生话音刚落，就看见一柄剑顶着自己的脖子。

男生顿时吓得语无伦次：“你你你，你要干什么？”

“干什么？信不信我现在把你杀了都没人会管我？”林夕调笑着看着男生说道

男生顿时不敢再说话了。

林夕看了一眼男生说道：“怂包。”随后转身便准备走

这是系统提示音又一次响了起来

“叮劝说马洁跟随自己”

“任务成功奖励经验值100”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Then another system prompt sounded...

"Congratulations on completing the mission of rescuing Ma Jie"

"Reward Distribution"

"Experience value +500"

"Enchanted weapons have been issued"

Lin Xi unfolded her own panel properties in her mind

The experience has reached impressively (810/1000)

"There is still 190 experience left to upgrade," Lin Xi thought to herself as she looked at the experience points.

"Hello, classmate." A girl who was standing with Ma Jie came up and said to Lin Xi shakily.

"Is something wrong?" Lin Xi replied coldly to the girl.

The girl stuttered and said to Lin Xi as if she was afraid of Lin Xi: "Can you take me with you?"

Lin Xi asked doubtfully: "Why?"

The girl seemed confused by the question and hesitated for a long time, unable to explain.

"Hey, that boy, take us with you." Another voice came.

Lin Xi frowned and looked at the source of the sound. It was the boy who was the leader of the few people Lin Xi heard whispering about the conspiracy before.

Lin Xi glanced at him and said with a smile, "Why?"

"Why? Just because my father is the vice principal of the school."

Lin Xi smiled, smiled for a while and asked, "What if I don't bring it?"

The boy then said: "You can be expelled with just one sentence."

As soon as the boy finished speaking, he saw a sword pressed against his neck.

The boy was immediately frightened and became incoherent: "You, you, you, what are you going to do?"

"What are you doing? Believe it or not, no one will care about me if I kill you now?" Lin Xi looked at the boy and said with a teasing smile.

The boy suddenly didn't dare to speak anymore.

Lin Xi glanced at the boy and said, "Coward." Then she turned around and prepared to leave.

This is the system prompt ringing again.

"Ding persuades Ma Jie to follow him"

"Mission success reward 100 experience points"
